# Security Policy

- Report a security problem in private, and expect an answer before anyone discusses it in public.
  - Reporting a problem
    - Email the repository owner instead of opening a public issue.
    - Say which version you found the problem in, and how you triggered it.
    - List the affected files and any configuration needed to reproduce it.
    - Describe what someone could do with the problem, so the owner can judge how urgent it is.
  - What happens next
    - The owner acknowledges your report and tells you whether the problem stands.
    - The owner fixes a confirmed problem in the current release rather than in older ones.
    - The owner credits you when the fix ships, unless you ask to stay anonymous.
  - Scope
    - These projects drive Alibre Design on your own machine, so treat anything that runs untrusted script content as in scope.
    - Take a problem in Alibre Design itself to Alibre rather than here.
